title: Sources: Firmus plans to allocate ~50% of its IPO shares to existing holders, as investor demand far exceeds the offer size in one of Australia's largest IPOs (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Firmus plans to allocate ~50% of its IPO shares to existing holders, as investor demand far exceeds the offer size in one of Australia's largest IPOs — Firmus Grid Ltd. plans to allocate about half of the shares in its initial public offering to existing shareholders …
